_comment: AD-1 PRIMARY GATE. `references` lists ONLY packages/contracts.
packages/db, apps/*, and every infrastructure SDK are absent by design, so an
`import { Pool } from 'pg'` here does not resolve and `tsc` fails on the exact
offending line. Adding an entry to `references` or a `paths` mapping is one of
the two edits that quietly repeal the rule — do not.
`types: []` is the other half, and it is not tidiness. tsconfig.base.json sets
`types: ["node"]` for the whole repo, which put @types/node in scope HERE too:
`import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'` typechecked with exit 0 inside the
package that is supposed to run with no filesystem and no network (TD-1).
Emptying the list closes that hole. dependency-cruiser's
`ad1-domain-no-node-builtins` rule is the backstop, not the primary control.
